title: Contrastive belief-update measurement of reward-seeking on public Qwen2.5 models
description: Contrastive-SDF measurement and controls port cleanly to Qwen2.5-7B/14B/32B; the style effect was not observed (7B beliefs fail to bind, 32B tight null), while the honesty effect reproduces at small effect size, growing with scale: grader-ward shift +4.3 nats at 7B (n.s.), +9.9 at 14B (n=10 pairs, t=5.4), +5.0 at 32B (n=3).
